Hiring managers keep telling me they want "builders."

Then they post a job description with 14 required tools, a take-home that takes a weekend, and a five-round loop where round three is a values interview.

I asked one of them what the last person they hired had built in their first month. The answer was a document about what they would build.

Builders exist. They are busy building. They are not going to spend a weekend proving it to a form.

If you want a builder, send them a broken thing and a login. You will know by Thursday.
